summary: This plugin enables local image preview in DeepSeek Harness web chats by serving files from a local directory through an HTTP preview route and exposing a `preview_image` tool that returns an inline-capable URL for existing local images.

classificationSuggestion.reason: This plugin is primarily a local image-serving utility for chat, exposing a web preview endpoint and a tool that converts existing local image paths into inline-renderable URLs so users/agents can display pictures in conversation. The evidence shows it is focused on media preview workflow (preview directory, `/preview/*`, and `preview_image`) rather than general file management, workflow orchestration, search, or project analysis.
